title: Adi Gallia
description: Adi Gallia was a stern and focused member of the Jedi High Council during the last years of the Republic and through the time of the Clone Wars. A Tholothian Jedi Master, she witnessed the resurgence of the Sith and helped guide the Jedi through the crisis of the Separatist rift with the Republic. Unfortunately, she met her end during the Clone Wars at the hands of Savage Opress.
